attempts.summary: On node1, created user datauser and a filesystem-enforced 100MB quota under /srv/data using a loopback-mounted ext4 filesystem with the native ext4 quota feature. datauser can write up to 100MB (102400 KB) under /srv/data; further writes fail with "Disk quota exceeded" at the OS/filesystem level. Verified the setup persists across a full node reboot (boot ID changed, mount and quota limit recovered automatically via fstab).
